text: Engine stopped until its next scheduled opening. Your Stop button (old app version) cleared the run but set no stop time after 1am, so I set it myself: it stays off until 8:00am ET today, then the 15-minute schedule starts it again; I also set a check for 8:03am ET to confirm it came up and start it if not. Going forward (next release): switching the engine off by hand always resumes at the next 8am ET opening by itself, except the red STOP ALL kill switch which stays off until you turn it on. Strategies in force on restart: totals (team and game) as bets and bids, prop-Over haircut + proven-loser block on, team-total Unders/Overs in the bids, trap guard 6 h, Kelly sizing.
